description_en: The Caitya is located to the west of Karuṇāmaya Mandira (BUN0001) and is part of a group of fourcaityasand adharmadhātu maṇḍala,all of which are aligned in a north-south direction. The area surrounding the caitya is paved with black flagstones and has been encroached upon by some of the building materials used for the reconstruction of the Mandira.Generally, caityas follow the pattern of placing statues of Akṣobhya to the east, Amoghasiddhi to the north, Amitābha to the west and Ratnasambhava to the south. However, this Dharmadhātujinālaya Caitya displays statues of Vairocana to the east, Mañjuśrī to the north, Vajrasattva to the west and Amitābha to the south.This monument was constructed in 1983, and its anniversary worship is performed on the full moon day of Vaiśākha. Tradition dictates that an umbrella be placed on top of the caitya on the full moon day of Āśvina.
description_ne: बुंगमतीमा रहेको करुणामय मन्दिर (BUN0001) को पश्चिममा उत्तर-दक्षिण फैलने गरी ४ वटा चैत्य र एउटा धर्मधातु मण्डल बनाइएको छ । ती चारवटा चैत्यमध्ये एउटा यो धर्मधातुजिनालय चैत्य हो । यस धर्मधातुजिनालय चैत्यको गर्भमा राखिएको मूर्ति अन्यत्र राखिएकोभन्दा फरक देखिन्छ । सामान्यतया गर्भमा दिशा मिलाएर चारजना बुद्ध राखिएको हुन्छ । तर यसमा पूर्वतिर वैरोचन, उत्तरमा मञ्जुश्री, पश्चिममा वज्रसत्व र दक्षिणमा अमिताभ राखिएको छ । यो चैत्य नेसं ११०३ मा स्थापना गरिएको हो । चैत्यमा कुँदिएको अभिलेखमा निर्माताको नाम लेखिएको छैन तर स्थानीयहरूका अनुसार हर्षमुनि शाक्यले यो चैत्य निर्माण गरेका थिए । यस चैत्यमा आश्विन शुक्ल पूर्णिमाको दिनमाचौ छायेगुभनेर छत्र चढाइन्छ र वैशाख शुक्ल पूर्णिमाको दिनमा वार्षिक पूजा गरिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: The name of the founder could not be confirmed from the inscription. However, locals told us that the Dharmadhātujinālaya Caitya was commissioned by Harṣamuni Śākya.
